newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Nimbus CD to invest $17 mln in Luxembourg.
newsitem.headline: Nimbus CD to invest $17 mln in Luxembourg.

text.p: Nimbus CD International Inc said on Wednesday it would invest $17 million in a Compact Disc production plant in Luxembourg.

It said in a statement that the plant will be operated by EuroNimbus S.A., which is 70 percent owned by Nimbus and 30 percent by German newspaper and printing company Saarbrucker Zeitung Verlag und Druckerei Gmbh.
Nimbus Chief Executive Lyndon J. Faulkner told Reuters he expected a turnover of about $130 million for the plant, which is due to become operational by November.
The plant's initial capacity will be 20 million discs, bringing Nimbus' annual worldwide capacity to more than 260 million.
EuroNimbus will be able to produce audio-discs, CD-ROM's and DVD's (Digitale Versatile Disc).
"We believe that the DVD market is very important for the future and that DVD will replace the classical video-band," Faulkner said.
